notes: Eight statement environments, five labeled. Only two proofs carry \ref: the proof of thm_main (\ref{lem_eig} twice, \ref{lem_key} twice; it attaches by its [Proof of Theorem \ref{thm_main}] title). The proof of lem_key and of lem_eig cite nothing. 'By Cauchy's Interlace Theorem' in the main proof is prose (inferred lem-cauchy, not diffed). The three unlabeled environments get synthetic ids in section 1: the Sensitivity Conjecture (conjecture env, mapped to kind proposition), the Gotsman-Linial theorem, and the s(f) >= sqrt(deg f) theorem. The statement after the main proof is a bold 'Remark.' paragraph, not an environment.
